reason: The claim that every direct-envelope error is <= L^0*epsilon is not supplied by the permitted lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope. That lemma gives each P_U only as a c0*epsilon-projection, while it bounds the corner-algebra defect and subordination/complementarity errors by L^0*epsilon. No hypothesis or witness choice states L^0 >= c0 (indeed node 1.1.2 fixes merely L^0>=1 and keeps c0 as a separate coefficient). Thus the target-projection defects required in the four-corner datum cannot be put under L^0*epsilon by the displayed inference. They can instead be dominated directly by t_3 using c0*epsilon <= c0*W.L*epsilon <= t_3, but that missing separate argument means the present blanket inference is unsupported.
